package.name: calib_intrinsics_test
package.description: Diagnostics for the D455 color camera intrinsics, independent of the hand-eye calibration being diagnosed elsewhere: intrinsics_test compares a robot-commanded 3D displacement against what the camera measures; grid_intrinsics_check is fully static (no robot) -- reads a printed 3x3 grid of AprilTags with known inter-tag distances and checks the camera reconstructs that known geometry correctly.
